summary: Dedicated in 1934 above Mendocino National Forest, this enclosed-tower lookout went unstaffed in 1990 and still stands behind a gated BLM road.

access.note: Reached via a BLM road gated roughly 0.5-1 mile from the lookout; no sign references the lookout itself.

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL FIRE)

events.note: Dedicated July 10, 1934, after USFS built a road to the summit
Staffing ended due to budget cuts
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register March 20, 2016 (US 1125, CA 110)

evidence.quote: The site is one of the highest points in Mendocino County and is easily visible from 35 miles away.
Cahto Peak Lookout was dedicated July 10, 1934, following construction of a road to the summit of Cahto (Signal) Peak by the U.S. Forest Service.
The lookout has not been staffed since 1990 due to budget cuts.
Administered by California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection

evidence.supports: 2019 survey: weathered railings, loose shutter, broken decking
evidence.quote: Railings are weathered and could use repainting, decking surrounding lookout cab is deteriorating and broken in a couple places. One shutter is partially detached.
Access is via a BLM road. Road is gated approximately 0.5-1 mile from the lookout. There is one BLM sign which gives mileage to Cahto Peak, but does not reference the fire lookout.

evidence.supports: enclosed tower, standing, cross-referenced to NHLR US 1125, CA 110
evidence.quote:

notes_for_editor: Record's 'design' and 'height_m' fields are still null; NHLR only confirms it is an enclosed tower cab (matched by FFLA's 'Encl. Tower'), not a specific design code (e.g. L-4) or structure height. Current access level for visitors (open vs restricted) isn't stated by either source beyond the gated BLM road detail, so access.level is left unknown rather than guessed. Fact-check 2026-10-04: the original draft claimed Cahto Peak's own FFLOS registry number was 'US 2049, CA 155' — on the FFLOS list that number actually belongs to the adjacent, unrelated, 'Gone' listing for Cahoon Rock; Cahto Peak's own FFLOS row instead cross-references the NHLR number (US 1125, CA 110). Story and this evidence entry were corrected to drop the misattributed FFLOS number.
